purpose: Disable employee legacy login bootstrap after all five known employees are Native-ready and aliases are canonicalized.
invariants: Existing Native-ready users continue authenticating from D1.
A missing/non-native username returns employee-native-migration-required without contacting Apps Script.
Native-only remains false in this gate; hard native-only is a later independent gate.
Worker code must remain byte-identical by script etag.
All non-target Cloudflare bindings remain unchanged.
No frontend, D1 control, Accounting, EasyStore, or Apps Script mutation.
